source.title: המילואימניקים והכלכלית בראשות יועז הנדל וירון זליכה
source.licence: Names are facts reported by the press
source.note: A three-way merger — Hendel's המילואימניקים, Zaleika's הכלכלית and Einat Wilf's עוז — registered on 7 Sep under the letters די / צ / י. The NAME is confirmed by gov.il; the ORDER is not. No source publishes the merged list, and the pre-merger reporting put Wilf second and Yoav Adomi third, which the merger has plainly changed. Only these three are recorded, and even their order is inferred from Zaleika being a named co-leader.
source.verify: the whole order is unconfirmed — replace it from gov.il once the approved lists are published
